inline_comments.comment: The version bump type is `major`, but this PR only adds a documentation entry to the community integrations list — no code or API changes. A `major` bump signals a breaking change and would force a major version increment of the entire `mermaid` package, which is wildly inappropriate here. At most this warrants `patch`. Also, this file is an exact duplicate of `true-parrots-build.md`, which means two accidental changesets were generated. One of these two files should be deleted entirely.

Same as `full-clubs-learn.md`: the version bump is `major` for a docs-only change, which is incorrect. Furthermore, this file is byte-for-byte identical to `full-clubs-learn.md`, making it a duplicate changeset. Both issues need to be resolved: correct the bump type to `patch` and delete the duplicate file so only one changeset remains for this PR.

Typo: `marmaid.js` should be `mermaid.js`. The same typo also appears in `full-clubs-learn.md` and `true-parrots-build.md` (line 5 of each). All changeset descriptions should be corrected before merge.

This file is auto-generated by the `pnpm --filter mermaid run docs:build` script, which processes sources from `packages/mermaid/src/docs/` and writes output here. The file contains a header warning: "THIS IS AN AUTOGENERATED FILE. DO NOT EDIT." Any manual edits to this file will be silently overwritten on the next docs build. The contributing guide explicitly states "DO NOT CHANGE FILES IN `/docs`". Only the source file at `packages/mermaid/src/docs/ecosystem/integrations-community.md` should be edited directly.

The ✅ checkmark on sub-items like `[News]`, `[Source Code]`, and `[Bug Tracker]` is semantically inconsistent with how ✅ is used elsewhere in this document. In the existing list, ✅ marks native/built-in mermaid support (e.g., `[GitLab] ✅` because GitLab natively renders mermaid). Applying ✅ to generic repository meta-links like a news file, source repo, or bug tracker has no clear meaning in this context. These sub-items should have their ✅ removed.

general_comments.comment: There are three changeset files for a single PR (`.changeset/7123.md`, `.changeset/full-clubs-learn.md`, `.changeset/true-parrots-build.md`), but only one should exist. Two of them (the `major` ones) appear to be accidental duplicates from running `pnpm changeset` multiple times. The two `major` changesets should be deleted, leaving only `.changeset/7123.md` (with its bump type kept as `patch` and the `marmaid` typo fixed).

The GNU Octave entry includes five sub-items: Octave Repo Index, News, Source Code, Function Reference, and Bug Tracker. Looking at comparable entries in the list, sub-items represent distinct *integration surfaces* (e.g., GitHub lists "Using code blocks", a GitHub Action, and a Writer plugin — each a different way to use mermaid). By contrast, "News", "Source Code", and "Bug Tracker" are generic project meta-pages, not separate integration features. Consider trimming the entry to just the top-level package link plus at most the Function Reference, which is the most useful landing page for new users.
